notes: Demand includes all order statuses, consistent with config.yaml.
Exact duplicate lines retained, consistent with the established ERP-line policy.
Union of forecast and actual product IDs; absent product-month lines count as zero. Products outside the forecast catalogue are scored as zero forecast and reported separately.
MAPE excludes zero-actual cells, with excluded counts reported. WAPE includes these cells.
No retraining or recalibration uses FY2025 actuals.
Revenue accuracy is not scored: actual invoice revenue is absent and zero Base Price means unresolved price; VIP discount and billing definitions require reconciliation.
Repository forecast is the committed pre-actuals result. Local forecast was regenerated during setup and is a separately labelled sensitivity check.
